title: VISTA-Bench: Benchmarking Multilingual Image Translation with Image-Specific Rubrics
abstract: arXiv:2609.37287v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image translation is a fundamental capability of multimodal models for multilingual applications, requiring visual understanding and meaning preservation across languages. However, existing benchmarks have limited language coverage and often lack explicit image-specific evaluation criteria, making it difficult to comprehensively assess this capability. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce VISTA-Bench, covering 22 languages and 10 domains, and develop an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol. The benchmark combines sampling for language and scenario coverage with model-assisted, human-verified annotations that group related text into coherent semantic units and provide multilingual reference translations. translated_title: VISTA-Bench：基于图像特定评分准则的多语言图像翻译基准测试
translated_abstract: 图像翻译是多模态模型面向多语言应用的一项基础能力，要求跨语言地进行视觉理解与语义保持。然而，现有基准测试的语言覆盖范围有限，且往往缺乏明确的图像特定评估标准，难以全面评估这一能力。为了系统地评估该能力，我们提出了VISTA-Bench，涵盖22种语言和10个领域，并开发了一种图像特定的评分准则评估协议。该基准将针对语言与场景覆盖的抽样方法，与经人工校验的模型辅助标注相结合，把相关文本组织成连贯的语义单元，并提供多语言参考译文。评分准则明确规定了核心内容、语义关系以及可接受的翻译变体，从而对翻译质量以及视觉信息与知识依赖内容的保持程度分别给出基于输出的评分。
tldr: 该论文提出了涵盖22种语言和10个领域的多语言图像翻译基准VISTA-Bench，通过图像特定的评分准则评估协议，分别评估翻译质量与视觉及知识依赖信息的保持程度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VISTA-Bench, a multilingual image translation benchmark covering 22 languages and 10 domains, featuring an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol that separately scores translation quality and the preservation of visual and knowledge-dependent content.
